snippet.title: Disco Elysium on Android - Release Day Trailer
snippet.description:
So the body is *still* in the tree? 

Play the critically acclaimed RPG, #DiscoElysium, on Google Play now:

📱 http://tr.ee/discomobile

Explore the first four levels for free and then unlock all that Revachol has to offer in a single purchase.

Disco Elysium is available to play on Android in the following text languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Korean, Portuguese Brazilian, French, German, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Polish, Japanese, Turkish and Arabic.
